title: Bo Bryan commits to Georgia: Son of country music star Luke Bryan ranks as three-star QB in 2027 class
line: Bo Bryan, Luke Bryan's son and a three-star quarterback in the 2027 class, committed to the University of Georgia. Dad's tailgate plans are officially set.

title: Morgan Wallen Scores 24th #1 At Country Radio With “Been By Now”
line: Morgan Wallen scored his 24th number one at country radio with 'Been By Now,' topping the Mediabase chart this week. Number one is basically his default setting.

title: Zach Bryan’s ‘Young Manhood And Other Donatable Organs’ Debuts At #1 On Billboard’s Country Albums Chart, #2 All-Genre
line: Zach Bryan's 'Young Manhood and Other Donatable Organs' debuted at number one on Billboard's country albums chart and number two across all genres. Big numbers for something called an EP.

title: Miranda Lambert To Headline 2026 Dallas Cowboys Thanksgiving Halftime Show
line: Miranda Lambert will headline the Dallas Cowboys Thanksgiving halftime show for The Salvation Army's Red Kettle Kickoff. Pass the pie and the remote.

title: Finally: Brooks & Dunn is Working On New Music
line: Brooks and Dunn, the reigning CMA Vocal Duo of the Year, are working on new music. Boot-scootin' fans, start stretching.

title: Zach Top Brings Out Lukas Nelson For Incredible Cover Of Willie's "Last Thing I Needed First Thing This Morning" In Arkansas
line: Zach Top brought out Lukas Nelson in Arkansas for a cover of Willie Nelson's 'Last Thing I Needed First Thing This Morning.' Arkansas got a night worth bragging about.

title: Hannah Harper Sings Dolly Parton’s ‘9 to 5’ at Dollywood: WATCH
line: 'Idol' winner Hannah Harper sang Dolly Parton's '9 to 5' at Dollywood, in an outfit that paid tribute to another Dolly song. Working nine to five never looked so good.

title: Florida Georgia Line expands comeback with 2027 ‘Anything Goes Again: The Festival Tour’
line: Florida Georgia Line is expanding its comeback with 'Anything Goes Again: The Festival Tour' in 2027. The cruise is back on the road.

title: Country star Cody Johnson says Nashville wanted to change him before success
line: Cody Johnson says Nashville wanted to change him before he found success. Good thing he kept the hat.

title: Boyz II Men to release their first country music album | Exclusive
line: Boyz II Men are releasing their first country album. Those harmonies are getting a twang.

title: Amy Grant and Vince Gill set 2026 return for "Christmas at the Ryman"
line: Amy Grant and Vince Gill are bringing back 'Christmas at the Ryman' in 2026. Nashville's coziest tradition returns.

title: Billy Strings Makes It Five Entertainer of the Year Wins at 2026 IBMA Awards
line: Billy Strings won Entertainer of the Year at the IBMA Bluegrass Awards in Chattanooga, Tennessee, his fifth time taking that prize. Five wins, a whole banjo's worth.

title: Brothers Osborne And Cody Johnson Team Up For Nostalgic New Duet, “Born And Raised Hell”
line: Brothers Osborne released their new album Watertown on Oct. 23, with a duet featuring Cody Johnson called Born and Raised Hell. Three good old boys, one great song.

title: Ella Langley Joins Shania Twain In Elite Company As “Loving Life Again” Goes #1 On Country Radio
line: Ella Langley's Loving Life Again just hit number one on country radio, putting her in elite company with Shania Twain. 2026 really is her year.

title: Carly Pearce Welcomes Kelsea Ballerini for Two Surprise Duets at New York Tour Finale
line: Carly Pearce brought out Kelsea Ballerini for two surprise duets at her New York tour finale and called her one of her best friends in the whole world. Besties make the best harmonies.

title: Morgan Wallen Curates His Own 24/7 SiriusXM Channel, Morgan Wallen Radio
line: Morgan Wallen now has his own 24/7 SiriusXM channel, Morgan Wallen Radio, and he curates it himself. All Wallen, all day.

title: Smithsonian's baby red panda named Dolly after country music icon wins vote
line: The Smithsonian's baby red panda was named Dolly, after the country music icon, in a public vote. Nine to five, nap to snack.

title: Ella Langley Pays Tribute to Dolly Parton With Smoldering Version of ‘Jolene’
signal: Wikipedia: 34K reads yesterday (Dolly Parton) · Ella Langley: #2 on Country Airplay
line: Ella Langley sang a fiery version of Dolly Parton's 1974 hit Jolene at the CMA's I Will Always Love You tribute to Dolly. Jolene, consider yourself warned.

title: Kelsea Ballerini Brings Dolly Parton’s ‘Here You Come Again’ to Life in Heartfelt Tribute to Her Musical Hero
line: Kelsea Ballerini sang Dolly Parton's Here You Come Again at the CMA tribute and ended with, We love you, Miss Dolly. Everybody does.

title: Country Music Association announces $1 million donation to Dolly Parton’s Imagination Library
line: The Country Music Association is giving one million dollars to Dolly Parton's Imagination Library. That's a lot of bedtime stories.

title: Zach Top Brings His Sold-Out Red Rocks Shows to the Drive-In for New Concert Film
line: Zach Top is bringing his sold-out Red Rocks shows to drive-in theaters as a concert film. Pass the popcorn and the cowboy hat.

title: Kacey Musgraves Is Holding onto Her Texas State of Mind in New ‘Middle of Nowhere’ Deluxe Tracks
line: Kacey Musgraves announced Middle of Nowhere Volume 2: Tex Mex Tapes and previewed two new songs, Weekend in Texas and Mi Tesoro. Queso not included.

title: Lainey Wilson Joins Marty Stuart for Unveiling of "Wildflowers and Wild Horses" Mural in Downtown Philadelphia, Mississippi
line: Lainey Wilson and Marty Stuart unveiled a Wildflowers and Wild Horses mural in downtown Philadelphia, Mississippi. Bell-bottoms in paint form.

title: Luke Combs extends record with 23rd consecutive No. 1 for ‘Be By You’
line: Luke Combs extended his record with his 23rd straight number one on country radio, Be By You. At this point, just give him the chart.

title: Riley Green Reveals He Wants to Be a Dad
line: Riley Green says he wants to be a dad and pictures camo, hunting trips and plenty of new songs. Baby's first tree stand.

title: Cole Swindell turns family memories into new single ‘Bronco’
line: Cole Swindell turned family memories into his new single, Bronco. Every family has a Bronco story.

title: Brooks & Dunn Celebrate 35 Years of ‘Brand New Man’ With Surprise Nashville Show
line: Brooks and Dunn played a surprise Nashville show to celebrate 35 years of their Brand New Man album. Not so brand new anymore.

title: Emily Ann Roberts to Embark On First-Ever Headline Run, ‘The Thread Tour,’ in 2027
line: Emily Ann Roberts launches her first headlining run, The Thread Tour, hitting 23 cities in spring 2027. Sew far, sew good.

title: Little Big Town, HARDY & More to Lead ‘Nashville’s Big Bash’ New Year’s Eve Celebration
line: Little Big Town, HARDY and the Red Clay Strays lead New Year's Eve Live: Nashville's Big Bash Dec. 31 on CBS and Paramount Plus. Staying up till midnight just got easier.

title: Emmy Award-Winning Duo The War and Treaty to Receive Inaugural Origins Vanguard Award at 2026 Origins Impact Awards
line: Emmy-winning duo The War and Treaty will get the first-ever Origins Vanguard Award at the 2026 Origins Impact Awards. Clear a spot on the shelf.
